searches.reason: Establish that diagnostics measure the deployed BERT4Rec task correctly before interpreting model weaknesses. Seek practical probes for target leakage, appended-mask inference consistency, and correct final-nonpadding readout under left padding. Include deliberately corrupted inputs as positive controls; report missing samples as unavailable rather than healthy zeros.
searches.query: BERT4Rec masked item prediction diagnostic tests target leakage bidirectional attention appended mask inference left padding positional readout training inference consistency

searches.reason: Turn feedback about broad relevance versus a compelling next choice into measurable hypotheses. Seek paired ranking tests using title/description evidence for specific compatibility, added capability, and recent interests. Separate explicit rejection, deferred interest, and unidentified items; treat ownership and mood as unknown unless supported. Validate these proxies against the available qualitative feedback without inventing preference labels.
searches.query: sequential recommendation diagnostic evaluation broad relevance versus specific intent compatibility redundancy temporal intent paired ranking tests qualitative user feedback abstention missing item metadata

searches.reason: Replace isolated embedding and margin summaries with controlled interventions that connect failures to sequence use and training signals. Compare recent-history removal, order shuffling, and matched item replacement using training-history prefixes with held-out masked targets. Seek repeated-sampling uncertainty estimates and popularity/history-length stratification to distinguish reliable effects from sampling artifacts, while preserving the host validation protocol.
